blocks.text: Zscaler recommends that you evaluate your service configuration to confirm there is no service outage before deleting disconnected App Connectors.
This article describes how to delete disconnected App Connectors.
To delete a disconnected App Connector:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > Private Infrastructure > App Connectors.
Select the amount of time in the drop-down menu based on the amount of time the App Connector has been disconnected (e.g., 14 days, 30 days, 60 days, or 90 days).

After the filter is applied, checkboxes appear next to the App Connectors in the table. You can select individual App Connectors or click the checkbox next to Name in the table to select all App Connectors.
Select Delete from the Actions drop-down menu.
Select the checkbox to confirm the deletion, then click Delete.
